evals.prompt: Help me create a sales deck for our B2B SaaS product. We sell an employee engagement platform to HR directors at companies with 500-5000 employees. Our main differentiator is real-time pulse surveys with AI-powered insights.
evals.expected_output: Should check for product-marketing context first. Should apply the 10-12 slide sales deck framework: Problem, Cost, Shift, Approach, Product Walkthrough, Proof, Case Study, Implementation, ROI/Value, Pricing, and Next Steps. Should tailor the deck to the HR director audience and employee engagement space. Should incorporate the differentiator (real-time pulse surveys + AI insights). Should provide slide-by-slide content recommendations with speaker notes and visual direction.
assertions: Includes Problem, Solution, Proof, Pricing, and Next Steps slides
Tailors to the named buyer audience
Includes speaker notes or talking points
